title: Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting dish from Slovakia, featuring pork dumplings in a light broth.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually add warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
2. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
3. Divide the dough into small pieces, about the size of a golf ball.
4. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
5. In a pan, heat a small amount of oil over medium heat.
6. Place a dumpling in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
7. In a separate pot, combine pork shoulder, onion, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper. Cook over low heat for 1-2 hours, until the pork is tender.
8. Add the cooked pork to the broth and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
9. Serve the pork dumplings in the light broth, topped with a dollop of sour cream.
